title: Outlook and Watch Status
user_story: As a rating analyst, I want to set an outlook or watch status on a rating so that users know the likely direction of the rating.

acceptance_criteria.text: Valid outlook values are POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, STABLE and DEVELOPING. Any other value is rejected with INVALID_OUTLOOK.
Valid watch values are WATCH_POSITIVE, WATCH_NEGATIVE and WATCH_DEVELOPING. A watch without a direction is rejected with WATCH_DIRECTION_REQUIRED.

A rating has either an outlook or a watch, never both. Placing a rating on watch clears its outlook. Removing a watch requires an outlook in the same request, otherwise the request is rejected with OUTLOOK_REQUIRED.
Ratings in default (Fitch-style RD, D) and status codes (WR, WD, NR) cannot have an outlook or watch; such requests are rejected with NOT_APPLICABLE_FOR_STATUS.
A watch that has been active for more than 90 calendar days is shown with aged_watch=true.
